title: 二叉搜索树的最小绝对差
summary: 返回二叉搜索树中任意两个不同节点值的最小绝对差。
insight: BST 中序遍历值严格递增，全局最小差一定出现在有序序列相邻元素之间。
pitfalls: 前驱需要可空状态区分第一个节点

solutions.title: 中序相邻值比较
solutions.idea: 递归生成有序流并维护上一值与当前最小差。
steps: 若 previous 存在则 best=min(best,node.val-previous)
更新 previous 并遍历右子树

code.java: class Solution { private Integer previous;private int best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;public int getMinimumDifference(TreeNode root){inorder(root);return best;}private void inorder(TreeNode node){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);if(previous!=null)best=Math.min(best,node.val-previous);previous=node.val;inorder(node.right);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun getMinimumDifference(root:TreeNode?):Int{var previous:Int?=null;var best=Int.MAX_VALUE;fun inorder(node:TreeNode?){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left);previous?.let{best=minOf(best,node.`val`-it)};previous=node.`val`;inorder(node.right)};inorder(root);return best} }
code.cpp: class Solution { optional<int> previous;int best=INT_MAX;void inorder(TreeNode* node){if(!node)return;inorder(node->left);if(previous)best=min(best,node->val-*previous);previous=node->val;inorder(node->right);}public:int getMinimumDifference(TreeNode* root){inorder(root);return best;} };
